name: atlas
description: Atlas monorepo task runner. The API itself is Python (uv); see services/api.

scripts.db:migrate: cd services/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd services/api && uv run python scripts/seed.py
scripts.api:dev: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:lint: cd services/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app tests scripts
